newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Ramos says 1996 good year for Philippines.
newsitem.headline: Ramos says 1996 good year for Philippines.

text.p: President Fidel Ramos has said 1996 has been a good year for the Philippines, listing a peace accord with Moslem secessionists and the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation forum summit as two of the main achievments.

"Let us thank the Lord for putting our country on the growth path that is going to lead us to our shared vision of the Philippines 2000," Ramos was quoted as saying during a Christmas party for presidential palace staff on Friday.
He said the peace agreement with the Moslem Moro National Liberation Front (MNLF) was his administration's biggest achievement this year, a presidential palace statement said.

Ramos and MNLF leader Nur Misuari signed an agreement in September this year aimed at ending a 24-year insurgency on the southern island of Mindanao. Under the deal, the southern Philippines has been given limited autonomy and the MNLF has been given charge of the provincial administration.

Ramos also singled out the successful hosting of the APEC summit in November this year. "It was no fluke," he was quoted as saying. "It took our people and the concerned citizenry a whole year of hard and thorough preparations."
